origin: Codex-assisted source review; not human approval, independent ground truth or unbiased accuracy benchmark
method: Reviewed every raw inventory item, question, synthesis, difference, impact observation and actual reaction against all 61 original messages. Model/automatic detection is read from the immutable pre-assisted effective snapshot, not inferred from post-review routing.
limitations: Selected eight-case regression validation, not an accuracy benchmark or causal comparison.
Multilingual coverage is Japanese forms and locale discussions, mostly in English; no broad translation-quality claim.
No refusal, truncation, interruption or recoverable failure occurred live; those behaviors remain mocked-test evidence.
Live severity was HIGH or UNKNOWN only; N/A, LOW and MEDIUM branches were not demonstrated.
Confidence is uncalibrated and did not flag every scope limitation; it must not gate away source or review access.
Complete exported question inventory is not a guarantee that all implicit source questions were recognized.

findings.explanation: M02 E004 asks audio omissions versus transcript-field errors. E006 gives a useful local disposition: record a transcript/audio correspondence error, not a playback failure, with actual TL endorsement. Treating this as the most plausible practical handling answer is defensible under the new acceptance policy. However, it does not expressly allocate the score to one of the two rubric fields. The fully ANSWERED judgment at 0.95 has no note acknowledging that narrower field-allocation uncertainty. Preserve the local answer while asking Agent 3 to check whether an exact field choice is needed. This is a bounded scope limitation, not a demonstrated invented decision or a requirement to force OPEN.
